name: odin
description: Your company's rules and decisions in every AI agent: ask with sources, record decisions, give out work and check it, from ChatGPT and Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Your company's rules and decisions in every AI agent
interface.longDescription: ODIN holds your company's projects, rules, decisions and who does what. Ask it anything about the work and it answers from your company's record with its sources; record a decision or a note; give a task to the right person; and see what changed since you last looked. Every agent connects to the same ODIN with your Viliha account.
defaultPrompt: Ask ODIN what we decided about this, with sources
What changed in my projects since yesterday?
Give this task to the right person
